spans.s:
चेष्ट् चेष्ट्, cl. 1. P. A. चेष्टति, -ते, चि-
चेष्टे, चेष्टिष्यते, चेष्टितुम्, to move
the limbs, to move, stir, make effort, exert one's self,
struggle, strive, endeavour, be active, be busy or occu-
pied; to act, do, perform, prepare; to frequent: Caus.
P. A. चेष्टयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to move, set
in motion, move, impel, drive; [cf. Lat. quœro;
Cambro-Brit. cais.]

चेष्ट, अम्, n. moving the limbs, gesture; acting;
(आ), f. moving any member of the body; gesture,
action, activity; effort, endeavour, exertion, bodily
effort; doing, performing, behaving, manner of exist-
ence; [cf. कर्म-चेष्टा, अचेष्ट-ता, निश्-चेष्ट.]
—चेष्टा-नाश, अस्, m. the ceasing of every motion
or action, destruction of the world.
—चेष्टा-निरू-
पण, अम्, n. observing a person's actions.
—चेष्-
टार्ह (˚टा-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, worthy of effort.
—चेष्टा-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having motion, full of activity, active.

चेष्टक, अस्, आ, अम्, making effort or exertion;
(अस्), m. a kind of coitus.

चेष्टन, अस्, आ, अम्, making effort, who or what
acts or attempts any act; (अम्), n. motion; per-
forming, doing; effort, exertion.
चेष्टमान, अस्, आ, अम्, moving, stirring, struggling.

चेष्टयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, moving, impelling, causing
to act.

चेष्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, done with effort, exerted, done,
set in motion, &c.; (अम्), n. motion, gesture, act,
function; doing, action, behaviour, manner of life.
चेष्टितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be acted; to be managed.
